name: @kanzo-tech/testing
description: Kanzo component harnesses — a class per component that finds it and drives it by its ARIA, in Angular CDK's shape and with its names, run by Playwright in a host's end-to-end suite or by Testing Library in a unit test. Where a graph canvas draws, its element says, and a model double is registered by id in @kanzo-tech/llm/local's provider registry before the page loads. `./jsdom` is the vitest setup file a jsdom suite of Kanzo components needs.
//peers: All OPTIONAL, each its door's. `playwright-core` is the root's, and for its types alone: `playwright(page)` drives the Page a host's suite hands it and imports nothing of Playwright's at run time, so a host on `@playwright/test` or `playwright` has it already. `@testing-library/dom` is `./dom`'s, which queries with it. `@testing-library/react` and `vitest` are `./jsdom`'s, which unmounts after each test with the one and registers that with the other. Deliberately absent: `@kanzo-tech/ui`, `@kanzo-tech/graph` and React, which `./jsdom` reaches only as Testing Library's own peer. A harness knows a component by its ARIA and what its element says, never by an import, so it runs against whatever version of the components the page loaded — and it is why `ui` and `graph` can take this package as a devDependency without a cycle.
//gauges: One gauge per published entry, and one per tree-shaken import a consumer meets; `scripts/gauges.mjs` (through `.size-limit.mjs`) is what each measures, and every limit's reason — each raise, dated, with its before and after — is a row on /docs/design, *A gauge per entry, and its raises written here*.
